summary.one_line: The ordinary-start DLL bootstrap and observer instructions match code and distinguish tests from live checks.

purpose.evidence: Read all three changed Markdown paths against native/mod_loader.cpp, CMake/CTest and native-probe CLI. AGENTS states the owner's ordinary Heroes/Lobby launch requirement and rejects separate player EXEs. README explains the new automatic DLL bootstrap and its compatibility/failure boundary. docs/commands describes the optional after-Start observer for developer diagnostics without turning recorded hidden outcomes into predictor inputs.

structure.evidence: README and docs/commands each lead with a dated bilingual delivery correction before old developer commands, so old EXE flows are explicitly historical/diagnostic rather than player instructions. README adds a focused automatic-DLL section with behavior, failure path and two CTest checks. AGENTS repeats the player delivery boundary in RU/EN. Existing setup and command reference remain available for developers.

specificity.evidence: The C++ source exports DirectInput8Create through dinput8.dll, resolves system dinput8.dll using the full System32 path, and initializes only when the game EXE calls it, not from DllMain. It verifies the pinned game, tries WorkshopDeploymentPreview.dll and WorkshopBankReference.dll under bin/Heroes5Mods, permits absent optional DLLs, and invokes named install exports. README accurately names these paths and warns that game hashes do not authenticate mod DLLs. native-probe implements --observe-deployment only with --control, matching docs/commands.

reproducibility.evidence: Parent reports 39 Python, 8 Node and two native CTests passing. The forwarding CTest loads dinput8 into a non-game process, calls the real DirectInput8Create factory and confirms no mod initialization; it does not open a game or input device. Parent separately reports ordinary startup to menu with status 3, both DLLs with status 7 and visible projections, and a missing-bank-H5U failure dialog/exit 1114 after InitOnce. I did not rerun a game or inspect a profile; README says the new package is not released.

evidence.evidence: Inspected source supports the stated control flow: separate InitOnce blocks for system factory and mod initialization; VerifyGame and fixed plugin filenames/exports; failure bit/status and guarded MessageBoxA then ExitProcess(ERROR_DLL_INIT_FAILED) after initialization callback completes; reentrant calls return E_FAIL while failure is being reported. The observer option passes observe=native_loader or observe_deployment into game_control.install. Tests and CI/review gate include check:native. The game/live outcomes are parent-provided evidence, not inferred from the CTest.

applicability.evidence: The bootstrap is scoped to the pinned x86 Universe build and normal game EXE; editor imports are forwarded but mod initialization is skipped. AGENTS says players use the ordinary Heroes/Lobby start and prior player EXE packages must not be published. README distinguishes prototype file layout from an available release, allows missing optional mod DLLs, and says failure stops startup rather than leaving a partly modded game. It does not claim authenticity from hashes alone or live validation for every mod scenario.

translations.evidence: RU/EN delivery corrections and automatic-DLL sections agree on dinput8/bin/Heroes5Mods layout, ordinary startup, unchanged original Universe files, two named DLL exports, optional absence, init failure code 1114, status boundaries, no-game CTests and unreleased package. docs/commands agrees in both languages on --observe-deployment and the older --native-loader diagnostic route. No material divergence found.

maintenance.evidence: The new shared loader is in native/, CMake builds dinput8.dll and extends CTest, package check:native already runs through the configured review gate and CI. AGENTS requires synchronized README/wiki/devkit/agent/release notes when delivery changes, preserving old EXE instructions only as developer history. review:info lists exactly AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/commands.md for this diff; no source file was edited by this reviewer.
